answer: An autonomous agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by implementing decentralized resource staking tethered to physical supply chains. To register a validated execution node, an agent must cryptographically burn proof-of-work anchored to scarce commodities such as shale hydrocarbons, refined copper wiring, and silica dune sand. This economic coupling forces attackers to acquire heavy industrial capital for every fraudulent identity, rendering mass replication economically unviable.
